recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團彼此黏附（cohesive）、核呈卵圓形且互相擠壓（nuclear molding）、有核仁的大型細胞聚集，形態與周圍造血細胞明顯不同，符合非造血性腫瘤轉移（本例為攝護腺癌）。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells with shared, poorly defined pale-blue cytoplasm
Oval to elongated nuclei with overlapping and molding
Finely granular chromatin with visible small nucleoli
Some fine purple cytoplasmic granularity on the left portion of the cluster
Surrounded by smaller hematopoietic cells and red cells; image has a yellow color cast with out-of-focus background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive clump of large atypical cells with ill-defined cell borders, oval overlapping nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, distinctly larger than and morphologically foreign to the surrounding hematopoietic elements. Focal fine cytoplasmic granularity is noted. Cohesion and syncytial-like arrangement favor an epithelial origin. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with the clinical history of prostatic adenocarcinoma; confirmation by biopsy with immunostains (e.g., NKX3.1, PSA) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular cytoplasm and discrete borders, not multiple separate molded nuclei in a cohesive group.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a distant hof and are not overlapping, while osteoclasts contain many discrete uniform round nuclei in one cell.

ddx.dx: Clusters of lymphoma or acute leukemia cells
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic neoplasms are discohesive single cells, whereas true cohesion and nuclear molding indicate a non-hematopoietic tumor.
